mapper.select: SELECT gender, birth_date FROM tb_users WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_usage_events (event_date, event_type, viewer_key, target_key, member_type, gender, age_band, zero_result, created_at) VALUES (#{event.date}, #{event.type}, #{event.viewerKey}, #{event.targetKey}, #{event.segment.memberType}, #{event.segment.gender}, #{event.segment.ageBand}, #{event.zeroResult}, #{event.at}) ON CONFLICT (event_date, event_type, viewer_key, target_key) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO tb_usage_salts (salt_date, salt) VALUES (#{date}, #{salt}) ON CONFLICT (salt_date) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT salt FROM tb_usage_salts WHERE salt_date = #{date}
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.birth_date IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE LEAST(GREATEST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(${on}, u.birth_date))::int / 10) * 10, 10), 70)::text END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_usage_daily_stats (stat_date, metric, target_key, member_type, gender, age_band, count) SELECT #{day}, e.event_type, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'BANNER_CLICK' THEN e.target_key ELSE '' END, e.member_type, e.gender, e.age_band, COUNT(*) FROM tb_usage_events e WHERE e.event_date = #{day} GROUP BY 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 UNION ALL SELECT #{day}, 'COURSE_VIEW', '', CASE WHEN v.user_id IS NULL THEN 'GUEST' ELSE 'MEMBER' END, COALESCE(u.gender, 'UNKNOWN'), , COUNT(*) FROM tb_course_views v LEFT JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = v.user_id WHERE v.view_date = #{day} GROUP BY 4, 5, 6 UNION ALL SELECT #{day}, 'ENROLLMENT', '', 'MEMBER', COALESCE(u.gender, 'UNKNOWN'), , COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollments e LEFT JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE e.applied_at >= #{dayStart} AND e.applied_at < #{dayEnd} GROUP BY 5, 6
INSERT INTO tb_usage_aggregated_days (stat_date, aggregated_at) VALUES (#{day}, #{at}) ON CONFLICT (stat_date) DO UPDATE SET aggregated_at = EXCLUDED.aggregated_at
mapper.sql: COALESCE(SUM(s.count) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'VISIT'), 0) AS visitors, COALESCE(SUM(s.count) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'SEARCH'), 0) AS searches, COALESCE(SUM(s.count) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'COURSE_VIEW'), 0) AS course_views, COALESCE(SUM(s.count) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'ENROLLMENT'), 0) AS enrollments, COALESCE(SUM(s.count) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'BANNER_CLICK'), 0) AS banner_clicks
mapper.select:
SELECT to_char(d.day, 'YYYY-MM''YYYY-MM-DD') AS period,
FROM generate_series(#{from}::date, #{to}::date, INTERVAL '1 day') AS d(day) LEFT JOIN tb_usage_daily_stats s ON s.stat_date = d.day::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT keyword, SUM(zero_result_searcherssearchers) AS searchers FROM tb_search_keyword_daily WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY keyword HAVING SUM(zero_result_searcherssearchers) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC, keyword LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.target_key::uuid AS banner_id, b.title, (b.id IS NULL OR b.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deleted, SUM(s.count) AS clickers FROM tb_usage_daily_stats s LEFT JOIN tb_banners b ON b.id = s.target_key::uuid WHERE s.metric = 'BANNER_CLICK' AND s.stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY s.target_key, b.id, b.title, b.deleted_at ORDER BY clickers DESC, b.title
